description: End-to-end paid advertising campaign management: intake and account audit, campaign structure design, ad copy and creative briefs, and launch plan with measurement framework

required.name: platform
required.description: Advertising platform for the campaign (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn)

required.name: budget
required.description: Campaign budget amount and period (e.g., daily, monthly, lifetime)

required.name: target_audience
required.description: Target audience demographics, interests, and behaviors

required.name: campaign_objective
required.description: Primary campaign objective (e.g., conversions, awareness, lead generation)

optional.name: existing_account
optional.description: Existing ad account details for audit and migration

optional.name: competitor_urls
optional.description: Competitor URLs for competitive landscape analysis

optional.name: landing_page_urls
optional.description: Landing page URLs the campaigns will drive traffic to

optional.name: historical_performance
optional.description: Historical campaign performance data for benchmarking

optional.name: industry
optional.description: Industry vertical for benchmark comparisons and best practices

directories.description: All campaign management deliverables and plans
